ai.lead: Mona is your teacher and always will be. The AI assistant knows your roadmap and stays with you before, during and after every class, so no day on your path goes to waste.

before.title: Walk in ready

during.body: Corrections and new words are captured as they happen, and it helps you and your classmates in group work.

mona.eyebrow: The one who draws your map
mona.quote1: “No two people learn English for the same reason,
mona.quote2: so why follow the same path?”
mona.body: I teach English through conversation, and I plan a separate route for every learner, built around their goal.
mona.name: Mona

groupRoadmap.q: Is my roadmap personal in a group class too?
groupRoadmap.a: Yes. Groups are matched by level, but your stops, homework and between-class practice follow your own goal.

privateOrGroup.q: Private or group: which is better?
privateOrGroup.a: Private if your goal is urgent or your schedule changes a lot. Group if you enjoy practising with real people. We decide together in the free session.

aiWhen.q: When will the AI assistant be ready?
aiWhen.a: We're building it now. Leave your email to be the first to try it. Until then, Mona and your roadmap have you covered.

aiReplace.a: Never. Mona is your teacher and draws your route. The assistant just helps you stay on it between classes.

need.q: What do I need for class?
need.a: A phone or laptop, headphones and an internet connection. Nothing to install. Weak connection? You can join with audio only.
